The Style tab's Alignment, Width and Columns of the Rich Text block. Each example is labelled with its variation; select it in Universal Editor to see the values in its dialog.

Our approach

Tata Consultancy Services helps enterprises reimagine how they work, with technology, consulting and business solutions delivered across more than fifty countries.

Our teams combine deep industry knowledge with platforms, partners and research, so that every transformation starts from the outcomes that matter to the business.
